stormbringer.title: Stormbringer notes
items: Line up {Ascendance} with big trash pulls and boss burst windows, and cast {Voltaic Blaze} right before activating it (Wowhead)
When {Tempest} procs, cast it at 10 {Maelstrom Weapon} stacks; with multiple targets, spend stacks on {Chain Lightning}

totemic.title: Totemic notes
items: Line up the {Surging Totem} → {Sundering} → {Doom Winds} sequence with big trash pulls and boss burst windows (Wowhead)
While {Hot Hand} is up, use {Lava Lash} on cooldown

Rav'i: [광역 피해] Line up Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec) with Ravenous Stomp (145474 Nature to everyone). This AoE is also when the group uses its defensives (Topicx)

[광역 피해] Damage cooldowns go on every Ssscavenging shield. Pop Doom Winds (1 min) on every shield and Ascendance (Stormbringer, 2 min) on a shield whenever it is back, and break the shield quickly with Crash Lightning (Topicx)
[회피] If Regurgitate slows you, clear it with Spirit Walk, and if several players were hit, drop Wind Rush Totem so Jet Stream clears them together (Wowhead)
The Writhing Coil: [차단] Put Wind Shear (12 sec) in the Toxic Atrophy three-kick rotation, and set the order in chat before the pull (Topicx). If one is missed and slows stack, clear them with Spirit Walk (Wowhead)

[광역 피해] Drop Wind Rush Totem during Death Rattle so the group snaps the Vine Grip tethers quickly (Wowhead), and if you saved lust, press Bloodlust/Heroism with Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) for the Uncoil split and hit the five Writhes with Crash Lightning (Topicx)
[제어] Stun the Writhes heading for the Spiteful Hunt target for 3 sec with Capacitor Totem, and clear stacked Spiteful Venom poison with Poison Cleansing Totem
Zul'jan: [위치] Use Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec) first for the channel where you block the Ritual of the Fang beam with your body (Topicx). If it is back, also pop it when stepping into the Boneslicer line to clear Ritual Venom (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] If Ritual of the Fang party damage ramps up, top yourself off with Healing Surge to ease the healer's load
[참고] If you did not use Bloodlust/Heroism on The Writhing Coil, use it on this boss with Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) (Topicx)

Lightblossom Trinity: [차단] Kezkitt's Light Bolt (116379 Holy) does not need an interrupt rotation, so kick it whenever Wind Shear (12 sec) is ready. A successful kick triggers Windveil, reducing spell damage taken by 15% for 12 sec

[위치] Standing in Fertile Loam to block Lightblossom Beam means taking 77586 Nature every 1 sec plus the beam's 77586 Holy every 2 sec, so go in with Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec) up. When the beam ends, switch to Ghost Wolf to ignore the patch's 50% slow and leave
[광역 피해] The three bosses share damage through Thicket's Trinity, so hit all three together with Crash Lightning and Chain Lightning
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [해제] If you are rooted by Bloodthorn Roots out of range, free yourself with Spirit Walk (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Use Astral Shift for Thorncaller Roar (82435 Nature to the whole party over 6 sec), and survive the Lightcrazed Frenzy phase after 50% by raising your maximum health with Earth Elemental
[참고] If you hold Bloodlust/Heroism, press it below 50% when no Bloodthirsty Gaze chase is active (Topicx), and pop Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) at the same moment
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Put Wind Shear in the interrupt rotation for Warden's Wrath (48491 Nature), which repeats on the tank during Moonkin Form

[위치] If you get a Pulverizing Strikes mark with Grievous Thrash bleed still on you, stand still, aim the cone away from the party, and pop Astral Shift. If there is time before the cones, top yourself off with Healing Surge to clear the bleed
[광역 피해] Line up Ascendance (Stormbringer) or Doom Winds with Spirits of the Vale after 40% to end it quickly. If your route uses three lusts, press Bloodlust/Heroism here too (Topicx)
Ziekket: [차단] Pre-revival Lashers' Lightspore Shot (58189 Holy) usually targets the tank (Topicx), so kick it with Wind Shear. Revived Lashers are immune to interrupts and crowd control through Vicious Regrowth
[제어] When the tank grabs aggro in the middle of the adds, throw Capacitor Totem there to stun the pre-revival Lashers for 3 sec

[위치] The tank only soaks about three orbs, so soak the remaining Lightbloom's Essence orbs yourself, and take the stacking Lightbloom's Might (14547 Holy every 1 sec for 12 sec) with Astral Shift (Wowhead)

The Hoardmonger: [해제] After all mushrooms are stepped on, clear the stacked Toxic Spores poison from the party with Poison Cleansing Totem (Wowhead)
[위치] During Spoiled Supplies, drop Wind Rush Totem so the party can step on mushrooms quickly within 12 sec (Wowhead)
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Put Wind Shear in the interrupt rotation for Fractured Shivercore's Winter's Shroud

[위치] As a melee DPS, take the Fractured Shivercore next to the boss together with the tank (Topicx). Crash Lightning and Doom Winds hit the boss and the add together, so match its health with the other add the ranged DPS handle and kill both at the same time
[회피] Snowdrift cuts movement speed by 40%, but Ghost Wolf keeps your movement speed from dropping below 100%, so use it to dodge Raging Squall
Nalorakk: [광역 피해] Use Astral Shift when you take Echoing Fury while body-blocking an Echo during Fury of the War God (Wowhead)
[위치] If you are the Echoing Maul target and Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec) is not back, summon Earth Elemental so Primordial Bond raises your maximum health (Topicx: use a defensive as the Maul target)
[참고] If the third lust was not used on pull 14 or Loa Speaker Nanea, press Bloodlust/Heroism here with Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) (Topicx)

Kystia Manaheart: [참고] Save Ascendance (Stormbringer) and Doom Winds for the 20 sec Destabilized window (Wowhead). Push Kystia to around 40% on the first Destabilized so it ends in two (Topicx)
[차단] Kick one Mirror Images clone's Felstorm with Wind Shear, and stop stacked clones together with Capacitor Totem
Zaen Bladesorrow: [광역 피해] This is the second lust (Topicx). Once the boss comes out and the tank picks it up, press Bloodlust/Heroism, pop Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) together, and hit the worker pack and the boss together with Crash Lightning
[해제] Clear the Heartstop Poison that Envenom puts on the tank with Poison Cleansing Totem (Wowhead)
[위치] After Killing Spree ends, run back to the boss in Ghost Wolf
Xathuux the Annihilator: [참고] Line up Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) with Demonic Rage, when the boss takes 30% more damage. The third lust goes on the second Demonic Rage (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Use Astral Shift for the Infernal Crush window after Axe Toss (Topicx), and hit the Axe Toss axes next to the boss together with it using Crash Lightning
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Put Wind Shear in the Chaos Bolt interrupt rotation (Wowhead priority interrupt)
[광역 피해] Damage cooldowns go on the Furious Vilefiend and Wild Imp spawns (Topicx). Pop Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer), and stun gathered Wild Imps with Capacitor Totem to stop Felfire Burst
[위치] If you are late through the Demonic Gateway after Malefic Wave, follow in Ghost Wolf

Taz'Rah: [광역 피해] Use Astral Shift for Dark Bloom's group damage. This is also when the group uses its survival utility (Topicx)

[회피] Nether Dash lines follow their targets, so do not dash around in Ghost Wolf; move a little at a time so your line does not overlap other players' (Topicx). Use Ghost Wolf to get out of Umbral Rupture's 10 yd Void Fissure
Atroxus: [해제] Poison Splash and Mind-Numbing Poison are poison effects, so clear them from the group with Poison Cleansing Totem right after Poison Splash
[우선 처치] When a Toxic Creeper spawns, switch to it right away with Voltaic Blaze and Crash Lightning
[참고] Press lust when the first Toxic Creeper spawns, together with Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer). If all your damage cooldowns are up, pressing it right on the pull is fine too (Topicx)
Charonus: [회피] As a melee DPS, pre-position next to one of the two near Unstable Singularities in front of the boss (Topicx, Wowhead), and when targeted by Gravitic Orbs, drag the orbs there. Clear stacking Condensed Mass slows with Spirit Walk
[광역 피해] Use Astral Shift for Cosmic Crash's burst and 20 sec DoT
[참고] When Bloodlust/Heroism is back, press it with Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) (Topicx)

The Golden Serpent: [제어] Stun the Animated Gold awakened by Lucre's Call with Capacitor Totem so they don't reach the boss
[광역 피해] Use Astral Shift for Serpentine Gust
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Put Wind Shear in the interrupt rotation for Wretched Discharge from the Half-Finished Mummies and the Finished Mummies from opened crypts, and slow two stacked ones together with Capacitor Totem
[광역 피해] Pop Astral Shift if you are the Drain Fluids target, and afterwards clear Desiccation by healing yourself above 90% with Healing Surge
[참고] Lust goes on Mchimba (Topicx). The Shaman presses Bloodlust/Heroism on the pull and pops Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) at the same moment
The Council of Tribes: [우선 처치] Whirling Axes pile up the longer Kula lives, so stack Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) on Kula and kill her before the fourth set of axes (Topicx)
[차단] Always kick Zanazal's Poison Nova with Wind Shear, and if it goes through, clear the poison with Poison Cleansing Totem
[우선 처치] Break Explosive Totem quickly, even from range, with Voltaic Blaze and Lightning Bolt
Dazar, The First King: [차단] Put Wind Shear in the interrupt rotation for Reban's Deathly Roar

[우선 처치] Lust goes on the start of Dazar (Topicx). Stack Bloodlust/Heroism with Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) on Reban and kill it before T'zala joins at 80%. On a four-lust route, press it in phase 2
[광역 피해] Line up Astral Shift and Earth Elemental with Gilded Destruction

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] The tank kicks Frigid Shard right after the Hailburst ice lands and drags the boss out (Topicx), so keep Wind Shear as a backup for when the tank misses it
[참고] Line up Doom Winds with the intermission Ice Bulwark, and stun the Infused Whelp pack with Capacitor Totem
[광역 피해] The intermission with whelps and the shield is the heaviest group damage (Topicx), so pop Astral Shift as Frost Overload stacks build
Kokia Blazehoof: [차단] Put Wind Shear in the interrupt rotation for Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley
[우선 처치] When a Firestorm spawns, pop Doom Winds and kill it before the next Molten Boulder (Topicx). When it dies, get out of Burnout's 20 yd with Ghost Wolf
[광역 피해] Use Astral Shift when Inferno stacks build up
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [참고] Near the end of Interrupting Cloudburst, stop casting Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning and keep up damage with melee abilities such as Stormstrike and Lava Lash
[위치] If you are the Inferno Spit target, go to the edge on the side of the next Winds of Change, and pop Astral Shift the moment the 6 sec DoT ends and the circle explodes for 8 yd (Topicx)
[참고] Line up Ascendance (Stormbringer) or Doom Winds with phase 2, and after the merge finish the lower-health boss first (Topicx)

Adderis & Aspix: [우선 처치] Only hit the boss the tank marked with a skull (the one without Storm Blessed) (Topicx). When the immunity moves, open on the new target with Voltaic Blaze to shift your damage right away
[광역 피해] Use Astral Shift when splitting Thunder and Lightning right after the Gale Force knockback
[위치] If Gale Force pushes you away, switch to Ghost Wolf and come straight back to the boss. With the boss in the middle of the room, stand so your line does not point at other party members (Topicx)
Merektha: [제어] Stun the snakes released from A Knot of Snakes and the Hatch adds with Capacitor Totem and kill them with Crash Lightning
[해제] If you could not kick Toxic Viper's Poison Spit with Wind Shear, clear the poison with Poison Cleansing Totem
[광역 피해] Pop Astral Shift for Serpentstorm's group damage. This is also when the group uses its survival utility (Topicx)
Galvazzt: [위치] Pop Astral Shift on your turn to block the Lightning Spire beam
[위치] Use Ghost Wolf to get into position quickly when going to block a beam
Avatar of Sethraliss: [차단] Always kick Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock with Wind Shear

[제어] In phase 2, the Faithless Tormentors only chase the healer, so stun them with Capacitor Totem once they gather around the healer. Nobody else gets hit, so stand on them and hit them with Crash Lightning (Topicx)
[위치] Run to the green orbs dropped by dying Tormentors with Ghost Wolf and step on them quickly. Stepping on them is what heals the Avatar (Topicx)

384143.d:
소용돌이치는 무기가 추가로 5번 중첩됩니다.

소모한 소용돌이치는 무기 중첩 하나당 넘치는 소용돌이가 부여되어 다음 치유의 파도 또는 연쇄 치유의 시전 시간이 10%만큼 감소하고, 치유량은 10%만큼 증가하며, 최대 10번까지 적용됩니다. 이 효과는 최대 20번까지 축적됩니다.

384149.d: 번개 화살 및 연쇄 번개가 소용돌이치는 무기를 최대 10중첩까지 소모합니다.

384352.d:
주위로 파괴적인 폭풍을 방출해 주위의 적에게 8초 동안 1초마다 (전투력의 120%)의 폭풍충격 피해를 입힙니다.

질풍의 무기가 활성화될 확률이 50%만큼, 질풍의 무기의 공격력이 20%만큼 증가합니다.

384444.d:
파멸의 바람과 깊이 뿌리내린 정기의 지속시간이 2초만큼 증가합니다. 또한 승천의 재사용 대기시간이 60초만큼 감소합니다.

파멸의 바람 또는 승천의 지속시간 동안 폭풍의 일격과 낙뢰 사용 시 소용돌이치는 무기를 최대 10중첩까지 소모하여 적에게 번개 화살이나 연쇄 번개 100%의 효율로 방출합니다. 이때 방출되는 주문은 최근에 사용한 주문에 따라 결정됩니다.

444995.m: 특성 · 6.5% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 25 초 재사용 대기시간
444995.d: 대상 위치에 토템을 소환합니다. 토템은 즉시 진동을 일으키며 이후 6초마다 (전투력의 122.382%)의 불길충격 피해를 입힙니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다. 25초 동안 지속됩니다.

445035.d: 뜨거운 손이 활성화된 동안 용암 채찍이 대지를 산산이 부숴 80%의 효율로 세계의 분리를 발동시킵니다.

454009.d:
소모한 소용돌이치는 무기 중첩 하나당 2.00%의 확률로 다음 번개 화살이 폭풍으로 강화됩니다.

폭풍 (0.2% (기본 마나 중) · 유효 거리 40미터 · 시전 시간 2초): 막강한 벼락을 떨어뜨려 대상에게 (주문력의 388.125%)의 자연 피해를, 대상 주위 8미터 내의 적에게는 [(주문력의 388.125%) * 65 / 100]의 자연 피해를 입힙니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

Consumes Maelstrom Weapon for increased cast speed.

455110.d: 번개 화살과 폭풍, 연쇄 번개가 35%의 확률로 소용돌이치는 무기 2중첩을 반환합니다.

455123.d:
피뢰침 특성의 효과를 얻습니다.

피뢰침
[폭풍: 폭풍]  시전 시 대상이 8초 동안 피뢰침이 됩니다.

자신이 [폭풍: 폭풍, 번개 화살 / 번개 화살] 및 연쇄 번개로 적에게 입히는 모든 피해의 8%를 피뢰침이 함께 입습니다.

462817.d: 바람 질주 토템의 이동 속도 증가량이 10%만큼 증가하며 이동 속도 감소 효과를 제거합니다.

462854.d:
바람의 군주의 분노를 이용해 1시간 동안 대상 아군의 특화를 2%만큼 증가시키고 자동 공격 시 20%의 확률로 즉시 다시 한번 공격을 가하게 합니다.

대상이 같은 파티나 공격대에 속해 있다면, 모든 파티원과 공격대원이 효과를 받습니다. (효과 발동 확률: 20%, 100밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

469314.d:
세계의 분리 시전 시 불의 야수 정령 1마리를 소환하며, 파멸의 바람 시전 시 자연의 야수 정령 1마리를 소환합니다. 8초 동안 지속됩니다.

야수 정령
원소 정령 [문양: 랩터 정령: 랩터 / 늑대]에게는 불의 마법 또는 자연 마법이 깃들어 있어 8초 동안 소환사의 화염 또는 자연 공격력을 5%만큼, 물리 공격력을 5%만큼 증가시킵니다.

470057.m: 특성 · 0.3% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 10 초 재사용 대기시간
470057.d:
불타오르는 천둥으로 즉시 대상과 10미터 내의 적 5명을 감전시켜 화염 충격을 부여하고 (주문력의 400%)의 자연 피해를 입힙니다. 항상 치명타 및 극대화 효과를 발휘합니다.

소용돌이치는 무기 1중첩을 생성합니다.

1217622.d: 대지의 보호막의 충전 횟수가 더는 소모되지 않으며 115%의 효율을 발휘합니다.

1218047.d:
세계의 분리를 시전한 후에 15초 동안 한 번 사용할 수 있는 태고의 폭풍으로 변화합니다.

태고의 폭풍
태고의 폭풍으로 주위의 적을 휩쓸어 (전투력의 118.8%)의 불길충격 피해와 (전투력의 118.8%)의 냉기충격 피해, (전투력의 118.8%)의 폭풍충격 피해를 입히고 150%의 효율로 번개 화살 또는 연쇄 번개를 방출합니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

소용돌이치는 무기를 소모하여 공격력이 증가합니다.

1250364.d:
원소 공격력이 10%만큼 증가합니다.

소모한 소용돌이치는 무기 중첩 하나당 폭풍의 일격의 재사용 대기시간이 0.3초만큼, 용암 채찍의 재사용 대기시간은 0.3초만큼 감소합니다.

1252373.d: 낙뢰가 적중한 지역에 전기를 흐르게 하여 2초에 걸쳐 50%의 피해를 2회 입힙니다. 또한 낙뢰의 무기 강화 효과가 자동 공격 속도를 15%만큼 증가시킵니다.

1260644.d:
용암 채찍의 공격력이 10%만큼 증가합니다.

소모한 소용돌이치는 무기 중첩 하나당 활성화된 뜨거운 손의 지속시간이 0.20초만큼 증가합니다.

1260666.d:
전격의 불길 사용 시 소용돌이치는 무기 2중첩을 추가로 생성하고 30%의 확률로 불꽃 회오리를 발동시킵니다.

불꽃 회오리
화염 충격에 영향을 받는 모든 대상에게서 이글거리는 폭발을 분출시켜 화염 충격 대상의 8미터 내에 있는 최대 6명의 대상에게 (전투력의 99.682%)의 화산 피해를 입힙니다.

1262635.d: 번개 화살과 연쇄 번개가 20%의 추가 피해를 입히고, 20%의 확률로 소모한 소용돌이치는 무기를 되돌려받습니다.

1264688.d: 승천이 다음 번개 화살을 폭풍으로 강화합니다. (100밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

1270350.d:
번개 보호막이 민첩성을 3%만큼 증가시킵니다.

번개 보호막 시전 시 무기 강화 효과를 부여합니다. 정령의 궤도 특성을 선택한 경우, 추가로 대지의 보호막이 부여됩니다.

1279819.d: 대지의 정령이 더는 주위의 적을 도발하거나 위협 수준을 생성하지 않게 되지만 활성화된 동안 시전자의 최대 생명력을 15%만큼 증가시킵니다.

1: [차단] Take one of the two interrupt slots that keep Radiant Spellsower walking toward the tank, and kick Light Bolt Volley (174568 Holy, 4 sec cast) with Wind Shear (12 sec, 30 yd). A successful interrupt triggers Windveil, reducing spell damage taken by 15% for 12 sec, which also softens Holy damage such as Spouting Floret.

[광역 피해] Once everything is gathered, the Shaman presses Bloodlust (Horde)/Heroism (Alliance) (Topicx) and pops Doom Winds (1 min) at the same moment. Stormbringer adds Ascendance (2 min), and Totemic drops Surging Totem in the middle of the pack, then uses Sundering → Doom Winds. Pop Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec) for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec).

[제어] If a low-health Radiant Spellsower runs off with Call The Grove and starts Frantic Blooming (8 sec channel), throw Capacitor Totem (45 sec, 40 yd) on its spot. It explodes after 2 sec and stuns enemies within 8 yd for 3 sec, so place it well before the channel ends.
2: [우선 처치] A Lightgorged Lasher wrapped in the Lightbloom Pollination shield (absorbs 600108) is immune to crowd control, so Capacitor Totem will not work on it. Focus it with Stormstrike and Lava Lash to break the shield.
[차단] One Wind Shear (12 sec) cannot cover both Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley, so take one and hand the other to another interrupter.
[광역 피해] If Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec) from pull 1 is not back yet, top yourself off with Healing Surge after Spouting Floret ends.
3: [제어] With 12 Lashers in this pull, a Radiant Spellsower fleeing with Call The Grove is dangerous. If Capacitor Totem (45 sec) is back, throw it where the runner is, stun it, and kill it right away.
[차단] Put Wind Shear in the Light Bolt Volley interrupt rotation. As a 30 yd ranged interrupt, it can stop a fleeing Spellsower without chasing it.
[참고] If Lasher Spore Spines slows stack on the tank and make the next move hard, drop Wind Rush Totem (2 min) on the tank's path. Jet Stream removes slows from allies who pass through.
5: [광역 피해] Open with Voltaic Blaze and Crash Lightning while Sporeblight Belcher is pulled first, and pop Doom Winds once Virid Grovekeeper joins 5-6 sec later (Stormbringer adds Ascendance). Pop Astral Shift for Spouting Floret.
[차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast, 3 sec disorient) with Wind Shear. Wowhead lists it as a priority interrupt in this dungeon.

[제어] Thorny Saptor's Thornclaw Leap (193965 Physical frontal cone with knockback every 2 sec for 6 sec) can be stopped with a stun (Topicx), so throw Capacitor Totem where the Saptor lands. It explodes after 2 sec, so place it right after the leap.
7: [차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Wind Shear. If Wind Shear is free, also kick Leafy Grovecrawler's Seed Shot (116379 Nature).
[제어] When the two Thorny Saptors start Thornclaw Leap, stun both with one Capacitor Totem while they are within 8 yd of each other.
8: [광역 피해] Pop Astral Shift for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret, and if it is on cooldown, top yourself off with Healing Surge after it ends.
[제어] Stop the two Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap with Capacitor Totem, and when you have room, kick the two Leafy Grovecrawlers' Seed Shot with Wind Shear.
10: [해제] Drop Poison Cleansing Totem (2 min) after Potatoad Matriarch's Toxic Spew (2 sec cast) finishes and the poison (58189 Nature every 1.5 sec for 9 sec) is on the whole party. The totem clears one party member within 30 yd every 1.5 sec for 6 sec, so dropping it before the poison lands leaves nothing to clear.

[광역 피해] The adds are cleared first, so handle the Lasher pack with Crash Lightning and Chain Lightning, and save Doom Winds (plus Ascendance for Stormbringer) for the Potatoad Matriarch you engage afterward.
11: [제어] One Wind Shear (12 sec) cannot cover all three Lightfeather Petalwings' Disorienting Screech, so if the three are stacked and casting together, stun them all with Capacitor Totem to stop the casts.
[광역 피해] Pop Astral Shift for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret. Save Earth Elemental (3 min) for the heavy AoE of pull 12 right after.
12: [광역 피해] This is the last big pull, so spend Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) or Surging Totem and Sundering (Totemic). If Spouting Floret and Light Bolt Volley overlap, add Earth Elemental (3 min) to Astral Shift so Primordial Bond raises your maximum health by 15% for 30 sec.
[우선 처치] Among the six Lightgorged Lashers, target the ones wrapped in the Lightbloom Pollination shield and break it with Stormstrike and Lava Lash. Shielded ones are immune to crowd control.
[차단] Put Wind Shear in the interrupt rotation for the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley, and hold one that flees with Call The Grove using Capacitor Totem.

1: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss (4 sec cast, 135775 armor-ignoring Physical) with Wind Shear (12 sec, 30 yd). Wowhead lists it as a priority interrupt in this dungeon.

[제어] If the seven Ravenous Descendants stack attack speed with Ravenous Claws and the tank starts taking heavy damage, throw Capacitor Totem (45 sec) into the middle of the pack. After 2 sec it stuns enemies within 8 yd for 3 sec, which drops the 2 sec stacks.

[광역 피해] Once the eight Venom Leeches and the Descendants are gathered, spread Flame Shock with Voltaic Blaze and pop Doom Winds (1 min). Stormbringer adds Ascendance (2 min), and Totemic drops Surging Totem, then uses Sundering → Doom Winds.
2: [우선 처치] Focus Stormstrike and Lava Lash on the Ritual Chieftain to kill it first.

[광역 피해] Pop Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec, 40% damage reduction for 12 sec) for Blood Sacrifice (87284 Physical to the whole group plus a 162029 heal absorb). It is Physical, so Elemental Warding's magic damage reduction does not apply.
[차단] Kick Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Wind Shear.
3: [제어] When the three Primal Serpents walk down behind the pillar, kick one with Wind Shear, and if kicks run short while the three are within 8 yd of each other, stun them together with Capacitor Totem to stop the remaining Piercing Hiss.
[광역 피해] If the Astral Shift used on pull 2 is not back, top yourself off with Healing Surge before Blood Sacrifice.
4: [우선 처치] Line up Doom Winds on the Ritual Chieftain to kill it before several Blood Sacrifices land, and take one Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Wind Shear.
5: [광역 피해] This is the biggest pull at 103 trash. Spend Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) or Surging Totem and Sundering (Totemic), and melt the Ritual Chieftain first.

[광역 피해] When Blood Sacrifice overlaps with the two Twinfang Harrowers' Paralyzing Shots DoTs (48491 Nature every sec for 20 sec), pop Astral Shift, and if that is not enough, summon Earth Elemental (3 min) so Primordial Bond raises your maximum health by 15% for 30 sec.
7: [제어] As Wowhead recommends, save Capacitor Totem for High Evolutionist's Evolve (6 sec channel). The 3 sec stun breaks the channel to deny the shield and crowd-control immunity, and also stops the three nearby Bloodletters' melee swings.
[차단] Always kick an Envenom or Mass Envenom (3.5 sec cast) coming right before Rattling Writhe's Rattle with Wind Shear.
[광역 피해] Pop Astral Shift for Rattle (58189 armor-ignoring Physical every sec for 5 sec).
8: [제어] When the four Bloodletters gather around the tank, stun them all for 3 sec with Capacitor Totem to delay the blood pools.
[광역 피해] If the Astral Shift used on pull 7 is not back, top yourself off with Healing Surge before Rattle.
9: [차단] Kick the High Evolutionist standing far to the left from range with Wind Shear (30 yd) on Mass Envenom so it walks toward the pack. When nobody else has a ranged interrupt, an Enhancement Shaman can take this job.
[제어] Break the remaining High Evolutionist's Evolve with Capacitor Totem, and pop Doom Winds to kill both before the second Mass Envenom.
11: [차단] Kick your assigned High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom with Wind Shear.
[제어] When several High Evolutionists channel Evolve together, stun them all with one Capacitor Totem. It explodes after 2 sec, so throw it as soon as the channel starts.
12: [우선 처치] Ascendant Serpent must die before the third Infest, so line up Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) on this mini-boss.
[광역 피해] When Infest hits you (34914 Nature every sec for 5 sec, then 69827 Nature within 8 yd), pop Astral Shift. It is magic damage, so Elemental Warding cuts another 8%.
13: [차단] Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom must be kicked every time, so save Wind Shear (12 sec) for the Chosen. Wowhead also lists it as a priority interrupt.
[우선 처치] Popping Doom Winds and Crash Lightning while the six Living Venoms are stacked makes them burst together, so kill the Chosen first with Stormstrike and Lava Lash.
[제어] Pop Astral Shift for Toxic Surge (29095 Nature every sec for 9 sec), and during it stun the two Blades of the Altar with Capacitor Totem to stop their Laced Edge teleports.
14: [광역 피해] If the Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec) used on pull 13 is not back, summon Earth Elemental for Toxic Surge so Primordial Bond raises your maximum health.
[차단] Kick Mass Envenom with Wind Shear, and if Capacitor Totem (45 sec) is back, hold the Blades of the Altar with it during Toxic Surge.
15: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss with Wind Shear.
[제어] Stun the four Blades of the Altar together with Capacitor Totem while they are stacked.
16: [우선 처치] Stack Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) or Surging Totem and Sundering (Totemic) to kill Ula'tek's Chosen before the second Toxic Surge. Kick Mass Envenom with Wind Shear.

[광역 피해] The two Ritual Chieftains' Blood Sacrifices come back to back, so take the first with Astral Shift and the second with Earth Elemental (Primordial Bond). If your health drops below 35%, Nature's Guardian instantly heals you for 40% of your maximum health (once every 45 sec).
[제어] Stun the two Blades of the Altar with Capacitor Totem during Toxic Surge.

1: [광역 피해] This is the lust pull where Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard are pulled together (Topicx). The Shaman presses Bloodlust (Horde)/Heroism (Alliance) and pops Doom Winds (1 min) at the same moment. Stormbringer adds Ascendance (2 min), and Totemic drops Surging Totem, then uses Sundering → Doom Winds.

[우선 처치] Focus Stormstrike and Lava Lash on Bribed Captain to kill it first, then move to Bribed Guard. The Captain's Deep Corruption aura gives nearby enemies 25% AoE damage reduction, so single-target buttons beat Crash Lightning here.
2: [차단] Take one of the two Seductive Sayaads' Seduction (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient) with Wind Shear (12 sec, 30 yd). Wowhead lists it as a priority interrupt.
[제어] If the two Sayaads pulled out the door cast Seduction together and kicks run short, stun them together for 3 sec with Capacitor Totem (45 sec).
4: [해제] With four Street Sneaks, Heartstop Poison stacks quickly (Topicx), so drop Poison Cleansing Totem (2 min) within 30 yd of the tank after the stacks land on the tank. It clears one player every 1.5 sec for 6 sec, so dropping it early leaves nothing to clear.
5: [우선 처치] Focus Doom Winds and Stormstrike on Massive Felwyrm to kill it first. It casts Massive Fel Detonation on death (5 sec cast, 290947 Fire within 10 yd), so step 10 yd away when you see the cast and come back after.
8: [차단] Kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast, 60% damage reduction and crowd-control immunity for 1 min) with Wind Shear. Wowhead lists it as a priority interrupt, and Enhancement cannot remove the enrage.

[우선 처치] When Shivan Punisher drops below 50% and starts Demonic Frenzy (29095 Fire to the group every sec), pop Doom Winds to focus it down, and pop Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec) if the damage piles up.
[회피] When you see Shivan Punisher's Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 290947 Physical within 12 yd), step out of 12 yd and return with Stormstrike.
9: [해제] Clear Corrupted Warlock's Curse of Doom (581895 Shadow after 10 sec, split within 4 yd) right away with Cleanse Spirit (8 sec). Wowhead lists this as the Cleanse Spirit use.
[광역 피해] If you are the Drain Life target, pop Astral Shift (Topicx). Otherwise the Warlock heals a lot.
[차단] Take one of the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage with Wind Shear.
10: [차단] Kick Fel Invoker's first Health Funnel (30 sec channel) with Wind Shear (Topicx).
[우선 처치] When Shivan Punisher drops below 50%, pop Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) to kill it right away. Pop Astral Shift if Demonic Frenzy damage piles up.
11: [광역 피해] Stack Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) or Surging Totem and Sundering (Totemic) on Felmaster Lucsei so Blade Dance (group Fire damage) does not come out more than three times (Topicx).

[광역 피해] This pull calls for splitting personal and group defensives (Topicx), so pop Astral Shift for the first Blade Dance and summon Earth Elemental (3 min) for the next so Primordial Bond raises your maximum health by 15% for 30 sec.
13: [광역 피해] Pop Astral Shift for Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (145474 Fire to the group). It is magic damage, so Elemental Warding cuts another 8%.
[제어] Throw Capacitor Totem where the six Unleashed Imps and the Wrathguard Flayers are gathered to stop Felfire Burst and Fel Rage casts together.
14: [차단] Take one of the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage with Wind Shear, and hand Fel Invoker's Health Funnel to another interrupter.
[제어] If Capacitor Totem (45 sec) is back, throw it on the pack of six Unleashed Imps to stun them together.
15: [해제] Clear Corrupted Warlock's Curse of Doom right away with Cleanse Spirit. Drain Life overlapping with the Punisher's Demonic Frenzy is lethal (Topicx), so kill the Warlock first.
[광역 피해] Pop Astral Shift if you are the Drain Life target, and if it is not available for Shivan Punisher's Demonic Frenzy below 50%, survive it with Earth Elemental (Primordial Bond).
16: [광역 피해] Defiled Golem's AoE must end within two casts (Topicx), so stack Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) or Surging Totem and Sundering (Totemic) on the Golem. Use Astral Shift for the first Defiled Slam and Earth Elemental for the second.

1: [광역 피해] This is the first lust pull (Topicx). The Shaman presses Bloodlust (Horde)/Heroism (Alliance) and pops Doom Winds (1 min) at the same moment. Stormbringer adds Ascendance (2 min), and Totemic drops Surging Totem, then uses Sundering → Doom Winds.

[해제] Clear the Insatiable Hunger curse (15% maximum health reduction, stacking) from Spirit of Hunger's Starvation Effigy totem with Cleanse Spirit (8 sec). Wowhead lists this as the Cleanse Spirit use in this dungeon.
[광역 피해] Pop Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec, 40% damage reduction for 12 sec) for the Feast of Misery channel (38793 Shadow every sec for 5 sec). It is magic damage, so Elemental Warding cuts another 8%.
2: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast) with Wind Shear (12 sec, 30 yd). Wowhead lists it as a priority interrupt, and if one goes through and the heal lands, remove it with Purge.
[해제] When Insatiable Hunger curse stacks build, clear them with Cleanse Spirit so they never pass 2 stacks.
3: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze with Wind Shear, and remove it with Purge if missed. Clear the Insatiable Hunger curse with Cleanse Spirit.
4: [해제] Clear Spirit of Hunger's Insatiable Hunger curse with Cleanse Spirit (8 sec). If the Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec) used on pull 1 is not back, top yourself off with Healing Surge after Feast of Misery.
7: [차단] This is the cooldown pull after the boss (Topicx). Take one of the two Earthwhisper Tenders' Healing Breeze with Wind Shear, and if the other one's heal lands, remove it with Purge.
[광역 피해] Spend Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) or Surging Totem and Sundering (Totemic) on this pull.
8: [우선 처치] While Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward shield is up, the whole group takes 24246 Nature every 2 sec, so focus Stormstrike and Lava Lash to break the shield first.
9: [광역 피해] This is the second lust pull (Topicx). If Bloodlust/Heroism is back, press it with Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer).

[차단] Kick Frigid Mauler's Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast) with Wind Shear. If one goes through and the group's movement speed drops by 50%, drop Wind Rush Totem (2 min) so Jet Stream clears everyone (Wowhead).
10: [차단] Take one of the two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar with Wind Shear. If both cast together and kicks run short, stun them together for 3 sec with Capacitor Totem (45 sec).
11: [우선 처치] Line up Doom Winds on Avatar of Determination to kill it first, then break Terra Rumbler's shield with Stormstrike and Lava Lash.
[해제] If you are trapped in Glacial Tomb (38793 Frost every 2 sec), you can free yourself with Spirit Walk (1 min) (Wowhead). Then break your neighbors' ice.
13: [차단] Kick Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning (4 sec cast, 193965 Nature, up to 3 targets) with Wind Shear. Wowhead lists it as a priority interrupt.
[광역 피해] If the two Grizzled Warbringers' Primal Echo (armor-ignoring Physical, stacking) hurts on high keys, pop Astral Shift.
14: [우선 처치] Break the two Ruthless Totemcallers' Magma Totems (36368 Fire every 0.3 sec) right away with Stormstrike. Voltaic Blaze and Crash Lightning also hit the totems.
[광역 피해] This is a candidate for the third lust. On high keys save it for Loa Speaker Nanea (Topicx), and if you use it here, press it with Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer).
[차단] Kick Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning with Wind Shear.
15: [광역 피해] The four Grizzled Warbringers' Primal Echoes come in turns, so pop Astral Shift for the first set and summon Earth Elemental (3 min) for the next so Primordial Bond raises your maximum health by 15% for 30 sec.
[차단] Take one of the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning with Wind Shear.
[광역 피해] This is a big 85-count pull, so spend Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) or Surging Totem and Sundering (Totemic).
16: [차단] Put Wind Shear in the interrupt rotation for Loa Speaker Nanea's Lightning Bolt.

[광역 피해] On high keys, press Bloodlust/Heroism here with Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) (Topicx). When Volatile Totems appear, hit Nanea and the totems together with Voltaic Blaze and Crash Lightning to finish within the second wave.

1: [광역 피해] This is the lust pull that takes the first corridor all the way to Voidtouched Magi (Topicx). The Shaman presses Bloodlust (Horde)/Heroism (Alliance) and pops Doom Winds (1 min) at the same moment. Stormbringer adds Ascendance (2 min), and Totemic drops Surging Totem, then uses Sundering → Doom Winds.

[차단] In the pre-assigned kicks, take one Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt or Voidtouched Magi's second Shadowbolt Volley (4 sec cast, 193965 Shadow within 60 yd) with Wind Shear (12 sec, 30 yd). A successful kick triggers Windveil, reducing spell damage taken by 15% for 12 sec.
[광역 피해] If you are the Null Eruption target (145474 Shadow within 10 yd plus a 5 sec DoT), step out of the group and pop Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec, 40% damage reduction for 12 sec).
2: [우선 처치] When Raj'kess the Spellstorm summons three Orbs of Disruption, switch to them right away with Stormstrike and Lava Lash. Voltaic Blaze puts Flame Shock on several orbs at once.
[광역 피해] Pop Astral Shift for Thundering Storm's long group damage (Topicx).
3: [광역 피해] This is the biggest pull at 158 trash. Spend Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) or Surging Totem and Sundering (Totemic), and pop Astral Shift for Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (87284 Nature every 2 sec for 10 sec).

[차단] Kick Angry Krolusk's Violent Sand (3 sec cast, 155172 Nature within 60 yd plus a 40% slow for 12 sec) with Wind Shear. Wowhead lists it as a priority interrupt, and if one goes through and slows the group, drop Wind Rush Totem (2 min) so Jet Stream clears it.
[광역 피해] If Brutok arrives while Astral Shift is on cooldown, summon Earth Elemental (3 min) so Primordial Bond raises your maximum health by 15% for 30 sec.
5: [차단] Always kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yd) with Wind Shear. Topicx calls it the most important kick in this area, and Wowhead lists it as a priority interrupt.
[광역 피해] Watchful Harrower comes with this pull, so pop Doom Winds, and if you are the Void Beam target, step out of the group and pop Astral Shift.
6: [우선 처치] When Brutal Overseer raises the Brutal Slams shield, stack Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) on the Overseer to break it. Wowhead also says to focus the Overseer at this point.
[차단] Kick Dominated Brawler's Demoralizing Shout with Wind Shear. Wowhead lists it as a priority interrupt.
8: [광역 피해] This is a damage cooldown pull (Topicx). Pop Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) or Surging Totem and Sundering (Totemic).
[우선 처치] Switch right away to the low-health mob (marked with an icon) that Devouring Brutalizer targets with Devour (9 sec cast), and kill it with Stormstrike and Lava Lash before the cast ends.
[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Wind Shear. Pop Astral Shift for Dreadbellow (29095 Shadow every sec for 12 sec, not dispellable).
9: [차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Wind Shear.
[광역 피해] Clear the ten Scavenging Siphoids together with Crash Lightning and Voltaic Blaze. If Astral Shift is on cooldown for Dreadbellow, survive it with Earth Elemental (Primordial Bond).
10: [우선 처치] Switch right away to Devouring Brutalizer's Devour target, and once the Brutalizer is low enough to die before its next ability, Watchful Harrower joins (Topicx), so pop Doom Winds then.
[광역 피해] If Dreadbellow overlaps with being the Void Beam target, pop Astral Shift, and if it is on cooldown, raise your maximum health with Earth Elemental.

1: [해제] On the way, while the tank stuns the Minions of Zul, remove their Bound by Shadow shield (Magic) with Purge (30 yd) to kill them. Topicx also says the Shaman and Mage handle purging the Minions of Zul.

[광역 피해] This is the first pull, so once the two Animated Guardians are dragged into the Shadow-Borne Champion pack, the Shaman presses Bloodlust (Horde)/Heroism (Alliance) (Topicx) and pops Doom Winds (1 min) at the same moment. Stormbringer adds Ascendance (2 min), and Totemic drops Surging Totem, then uses Sundering → Doom Winds.

[광역 피해] Shadow Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 164870 Shadow to the whole party) needs a personal defensive on every cast, so pop Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec, 40% damage reduction for 12 sec) on the first cast, and take the next one with Earth Elemental (3 min) so Primordial Bond raises your maximum health by 15%.
2: [차단] Kick Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Shadow plus a 12 sec curse) with Wind Shear (12 sec, 30 yd). A successful kick triggers Windveil, reducing spell damage taken by 15% for 12 sec, which also softens Shadow Whirlwind.
[해제] If Hex Volley goes through and a party member gets the curse DoT (38793 Shadow every 1 sec), remove it with Cleanse Spirit (8 sec, 40 yd).

[광역 피해] The corner pack is a separate cooldown pull (Topicx), so pop Doom Winds, and use whichever of Astral Shift or Earth Elemental is left for Shadow Whirlwind. If both are on cooldown, top yourself off with Healing Surge beforehand.
4: [광역 피해] Hold Doom Winds until the tank is on the awakened group and has aggro (Topicx). Stack Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) or Surging Totem and Sundering (Totemic) on the hardest group, King A'akul and the Bloodsworn Assassins, and pop Astral Shift when Sudden Rupture bleeds overlap.
[차단] Put Wind Shear in the interrupt rotation for Queen Wasi's Bind Soul (10 sec charm) and Soul Bolt, and Seneschal M'bara's Unholy Mending. The charm is the most dangerous, so kick Bind Soul first.

[해제] When Guard Captain Atu casts Captain's Bulwark (30% less damage taken, Magic), Purge it off the target you are hitting, and to delay the cast, throw Capacitor Totem (45 sec) on Atu to stun it for 3 sec (Method).
5: [광역 피해] Pop Astral Shift for Purification Construct's Purifying Flame (174568 Fire to the whole party), and if it is on cooldown, raise your maximum health with Earth Elemental. If your route lusts here on high keys, press Bloodlust/Heroism together with Doom Winds (Topicx).

[해제] If the Embalming Fluids pulled in near the end land Putrid Seekers (Poison, 38793 Nature every 1 sec for 12 sec and a 20% slow) on several players, drop Poison Cleansing Totem (2 min). The totem clears the poison from one party member within 30 yd every 1.5 sec for 6 sec.
6: [차단] Take one of the two kicks on the two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge (4 sec cast, 12 sec disease on the whole party) with Wind Shear (Topicx). A Shaman cannot remove diseases, so do not miss it.

[제어] If both Mummies are within 8 yd of each other and casting together, stun both for 3 sec with Capacitor Totem to stop the casts. The totem explodes after 2 sec, so throw it while more than 2 sec of the cast remains.
7: [차단] Take one Half-Finished Mummy's Wretched Discharge kick with Wind Shear, and if Wind Shear is on cooldown, stop it with Capacitor Totem.
[해제] When Putrid Seekers poison from the eight Embalming Fluids stacks up, drop Poison Cleansing Totem, and clear the Fluid pack together with Crash Lightning and Voltaic Blaze.
9: [우선 처치] Healing Tide Totems keep coming while the two Spectral Shamans are alive (Topicx), so kill them one at a time first with Stormstrike and Lava Lash.
[제어] The two Phantom Hex Priests cast Spectral Bolt and Hex nonstop (Topicx), so kick one with Wind Shear, and if they are stacked, stun both with Capacitor Totem.
[해제] Free a party member caught in Hex (5 sec polymorph, Curse) right away with Cleanse Spirit.
10: [광역 피해] On a four-lust route, this bridge pack is the third lust (Topicx). Press Bloodlust/Heroism with Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer), and kill Ghostly Brute (or one Spectral Shaman) first.
[회피] When Ghostly Brute starts Seismic Upheaval (5 sec cast, 387930 Physical to nearby players and a knock-up), switch to Ghost Wolf and leave melee range right away.
[해제] Free party members caught in Phantom Hex Priest's Hex with Cleanse Spirit, and use your remaining Wind Shear on Spectral Bolt.
12: [참고] Shadow Barrage goes to whoever engages first (Topicx), so do not hit Shadow of Zul with Voltaic Blaze or Lightning Bolt before the tank is on it.

[위치] If you are the Dark Revelation target (473120 Shadow within 20 yd after 5 sec), switch to Ghost Wolf, get more than 20 yd away from the party, and pop Astral Shift. As a melee DPS, leave the far Pool of Darkness to a ranged DPS or the healer (Topicx).

1: [차단] Put Wind Shear (12 sec, 30 yd) in the interrupt rotation for the two Flashfrost Chillweavers' Ice Shield (15 sec channel). The tank stops the first caster with a charge (Topicx), so take the second cast. A successful kick triggers Windveil, reducing spell damage taken by 15% for 12 sec.

[제어] When the tank's Tectonic Strike stacks get high, throw Capacitor Totem (45 sec, 40 yd) on the Deepstone Earthshapers to stun them for 3 sec. Topicx also says to stun the Earthshapers and move away to drop the stacks. Primal Juggernaut is immune to crowd control, so it does not work on it.

[광역 피해] This is a big pull gathered all the way to the doorway, so pop Doom Winds (1 min) and Ascendance (Stormbringer, 2 min) or Surging Totem and Sundering (Totemic), and kill Primal Juggernaut first. Pop Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec) for Excavating Blast (106681 Nature to the whole party plus an 8 sec DoT).
2: [차단] Kick Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Wind Shear. A shielded mob does not take crowd control effects, so Capacitor Totem will not work on it.
[우선 처치] Stack Stormstrike and Lava Lash on the crowd-control-immune Primal Juggernaut to kill it first, and get out of the Blast Chunks circles (6 yd) after Excavating Blast with Ghost Wolf.
3: [차단] Kick Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Wind Shear so the two Deepstone Earthshapers do not get shielded. A shielded Earthshaper cannot be stunned with Capacitor Totem.

[광역 피해] Each strike of crowd-control-immune Defier Draghar's Steel Barrage deals 24246 Fire to the whole party within 60 yd, so pop Astral Shift if you are low, and pop Doom Winds once Draghar is in the pack.
5: [차단] Use Wind Shear on Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt first (Topicx). Blazebound Destroyer's Fiery Blast only targets the tank, so kick it only when Wind Shear is spare.

[제어] Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage (10 sec channel) cannot be interrupted, so stop it by stunning with Capacitor Totem. The tank cannot stop them all alone (Topicx). Remove the Blaze of Glory (Magic) it starts on death with Purge (30 yd) (Method).
[광역 피해] Pop Astral Shift for the Destroyer's Inferno group DoT, and right before the Destroyer dies, get out of Burnout's 20 yd with Ghost Wolf.
6: [광역 피해] On 17+ keys, press Bloodlust (Horde)/Heroism (Alliance) when Flamegullet reaches 50% (Topicx) and pop Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) at the same moment. Below 50%, Molten Blood group damage grows 15% with each cast, so it must die fast.
[제어] Stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Capacitor Totem and remove Blaze of Glory with Purge. Use Wind Shear on Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt.
7: [제어] If the two Ashseer Flamelashers channel Flaming Barrage together, stun both with one Capacitor Totem while they are within 8 yd. Remove Blaze of Glory from the one that dies first with Purge.
[차단] Put Wind Shear in the interrupt rotation for the two Primalist Cinderweavers' Cinderbolt.
8: [참고] Do not use Voltaic Blaze or Chain Lightning while Thunderhead patrols nearby. Both spread to enemies around the target and can pull Thunderhead.
[제어] Stop the two Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage with Capacitor Totem, and use Wind Shear on Cinderbolt.
10: [광역 피해] Clear the six Storm Warriors together with Crash Lightning and Voltaic Blaze and pop Doom Winds. Pop Astral Shift if you are the target of Tempest Channeler's Lightning Torrent (7 sec channel, 65463 Nature every 1 sec).

[제어] Tempest Channeler is immune to crowd control and Thunder Blast only targets the tank, so use Wind Shear on it only when spare. Stop the Flaming Barrage of the Ashseer Flamelasher you chain into with Capacitor Totem.
11: [차단] The cast you must stop in this pull is Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt (Topicx). Give Wind Shear to Cinderbolt.
[광역 피해] Pop Astral Shift if you are the Lightning Torrent target, and if it is on cooldown, summon Earth Elemental (3 min) so Primordial Bond raises your maximum health by 15%.
12: [우선 처치] When High Channeler Ryvati raises Tempest Stormshield (absorbs 20% of its maximum health), stack Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) or Surging Totem and Sundering (Totemic) on the shield to break it fast. If the shield expires unbroken, everyone within 60 yd is stunned for 4 sec.
[광역 피해] While the shield is up, the whole party takes 29095 Nature every sec, so pop Astral Shift. If your route lusts Ryvati on high keys, line up Bloodlust/Heroism with this shield too (Topicx).

1: [우선 처치] Stack Doom Winds (1 min) and Ascendance (Stormbringer, 2 min) or Surging Totem and Sundering (Totemic) on the crowd-control-immune Sandfury Stonefist and kill it first (Topicx).

[차단] If Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt lands together with Ground Pound (4 sec cast, 156627 Physical within 60 yd and a knockback), people die (Topicx), so save Wind Shear (12 sec, 30 yd) for the Lightning Bolt at that moment, and pop Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec) before the knockback.

2: [참고] The two Shrouded Fangs below the stairs are stealthed, so do not run ahead until the tank engages first (Topicx). Kick Poisoned Cheap Shot (5 sec stun plus poison) with Wind Shear, and if it lands, clear it with Poison Cleansing Totem (2 min).
[광역 피해] Pop Doom Winds while killing Sandfury Stonefist first, and use whichever of Astral Shift or Earth Elemental (3 min, Primordial Bond raises maximum health by 15%) is left for Ground Pound.
4: [우선 처치] If Sand-Sworn Rider lives long, Swarming Krolusks adds run at distant DPS (Topicx), so stack Doom Winds, Stormstrike, and Lava Lash on the Rider. About 5 sec after engage, Scouring Sand (4.5 sec cast, 290947 Nature frontal cone and a 4 sec disorient) comes, so do not stand in front of the Rider.
[제어] Stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Capacitor Totem, and kick Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt with Wind Shear.
5: [차단] If the two Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt hits someone already hit by a Krolusk charge or Cytotoxin, they die (Topicx), so put Wind Shear in the Lightning Bolt interrupt rotation.

[광역 피해] Gather the rest first, and when Sand-Sworn Rider joins (Topicx), pop Doom Winds and Ascendance (Stormbringer) or Surging Totem and Sundering (Totemic). Pop Astral Shift if a Serrated Charge bleed overlaps with Cytotoxin.
[제어] Stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Capacitor Totem. Throwing the totem on the two Storm Adepts also stops their Lightning Bolts.
6: [차단] One person is enough for Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind (5 sec cast) (Topicx), so if it is yours, kick it with Wind Shear. Remove Addle Mind (Curse) from an affected party member with Cleanse Spirit (8 sec, 40 yd).
[차단] Kick Brood Tender's Venom Bolt (116379 Nature on a random target) when Wind Shear is spare.
7: [해제] If the three Poisonous Vipers' Cytotoxin (10 sec Nature DoT) is on several players, drop Poison Cleansing Totem. The totem clears the poison from one party member within 30 yd every 1.5 sec for 6 sec.
[차단] So that Venom Bolt does not land on top of Cytotoxin (Topicx), kick Brood Tender's Venom Bolt with Wind Shear, and free party members caught in Addle Mind with Cleanse Spirit.
9: [차단] Time Wind Shear so Imbued Stormcaller's Lightning Bolt does not leak when Release Charge (3 sec cast, 145474 Nature to the whole party) goes off (Topicx). Windveil reduces spell damage taken by 15% for 12 sec, which also softens Release Charge.

[광역 피해] The two Agitated Nimbus' Release Charges come staggered, so take one with Astral Shift and the next with Earth Elemental. Accumulate Charge (Magic, stacking 8% damage done) can be removed with Purge.
10: [제어] Both Imbued Stormcallers must be stopped before the other mobs are gathered (Topicx), so kick one with Wind Shear, and if they are stacked, stun both with Capacitor Totem.

[광역 피해] With a Nimbus, casters, and several Static Anomalies together this is a dangerous pull (Topicx), so pop Astral Shift for Release Charge, and clear the Static Anomalies with Crash Lightning and Voltaic Blaze.
12: [제어] The Temple Disruptor on the far side from Orb Watcher is held with crowd control (Topicx), so stun its Essence Disruption channel with Capacitor Totem, and kick the Disruptor on the tank's side with Wind Shear.

[광역 피해] Pop Astral Shift for Orb Watcher's Caustic Stomp (116379 Nature within 60 yd plus a 10 sec DoT). Do not rush the Loose Sparks section before this; dodge them, then kill the Spark Channeler (Topicx).
13: [제어] If Capacitor Totem (45 sec) from pull 12 is not back, kick the far Temple Disruptor's Essence Disruption with Wind Shear, and if it is back, hold it with the totem.
[광역 피해] If Astral Shift is on cooldown for Caustic Stomp, raise your maximum health with Earth Elemental.
14: [차단] The crowd-control-immune Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock (4 sec cast, 242456 Fire plus an 8 sec DoT) must always be kicked, so give Wind Shear to this cast.
[제어] The four Faithless Tormentors only chase the healer, so stun them with Capacitor Totem once they gather around the healer (Topicx), and kill them together with Crash Lightning.
[회피] If you are the Latent Hex target, get more than 10 yd away from the party with Ghost Wolf. When it ends, it deals Shadow damage within 10 yd and leaves Hex Muck.
